scope: all same-name variants in corrected UI/item/template intersection
primary_review: Sol directly reviewed fixed Git objects, all tier overrides, actual template bindings, execution-chain applicability and the current player examples.

content_review.result: Both actual trait variants have their own I–IV values: Laspistol 10/12/14/16%; Gauntlet 24/28/32/36%. Each own wrapper clones the crit-kill base without adding a different tier override. The base requires on_kill, held slot, exact attacking-item match, and actual critical flag plus attack_result=died; it has no ranged-only gate, cooldown, duration, or per-layer effect.

The callback directly requests recover_percentage_toughness with the tier fraction and ignore_stat_buffs=true. The own wrappers have no toughness_regain_multiplier producer, so the default multiplier is 1. Recovery budget is current maximum Toughness M times tier fraction p, capped by current missing Toughness D: R=min(M×p,D). Maximum can include current bonuses; recovery does not increase the maximum, and ordinary replenishment stat multipliers are ignored.

The native recovery rejects dead or prevent-replenish states. Knocked-down is normally rejected, with a force_assist component bypass for the knocked-down gate only; this does not bypass the separate alive/prevent-replenish checks. The README and math page describe that exception without treating ordinary assist as equivalent.

Each eligible kill event independently calls the recovery callback; the event path is not a coalesced boolean and has no activation cooldown or active duration. The examples correctly require sufficient missing Toughness before each full-budget recovery and distinguish the maximum-Toughness denominator from missing-Toughness capping.

The two exact bindings are Heavy Laspistol Accatran MG Mk II (laspistol_p1_m1) and Grenadier Gauntlet Blastoom Mk III (ogryn_gauntlet_p1_m1). Laspistol hip and aimed hit-scan attacks retain critical and item context; push omits a critical flag and Attack defaults it to false. Gauntlet ordinary light/heavy and the direct special punch use melee attack paths that can carry critical context; its separate secondary blast explicitly uses critical=false. Grenade direct impact and fuse/impact explosions preserve launch-time critical/item/owner context, while the held-slot gate is evaluated during event processing.

The same description key/hash f3f6d906 is preserved in English and Traditional Chinese. The own formatters display the tier fraction as +10/+12/+14/+16% for the Laspistol and +24/+28/+32/+36% for the Gauntlet; each static I–IV sentence substitutes only the placeholder and keeps the source wording. Omitted item, attack-route, denominator, cap, and state conditions are classified as documentation omissions, not translation contradictions.

The UI receipt resolves both family/pattern/mark names and exact trait-item append points, with no outside exact-name candidates. Both actual item.icon values use weapon_trait_124; the attached PNG is 128×128, HTTP 200, hash-verified and visually reviewed. The snapshot and current formal copies of all eight own pages have identical hashes; the map entry, reverse weapon pages, and indexes are in the fixed scope.

The frozen-source receipt verifies 50 normalized UTF-8/LF source ranges across 26 files at the fixed 1.13.1 commit; I independently recomputed those 50 range hashes with no mismatches. Focused check receipt reports 54 ranges/28 files, 885 bindings/450 variants globally, map consistency verified, 14 link-checked Markdown files with zero errors, and 14 GFM files.
